note: Generated TSX writes a length bound to a variable - padding, gap, a single corner radius, a shadow's offset, blur and spread, a font size - as the variable's `$token` (`px="$containerX"`, `boxShadow="0 $shadowMdY 20px 0 #00000026"`) when the theme generated from the same variables gives that token exactly the value written, unrounded, in the theme a page shows without `data-theme`, at the width the screen holding the node was drawn at. A responsive token then follows the screen width as the design's breakpoint modes do; drawn pixels held one width's value at every width. A length the token does not reproduce keeps its pixels. Widths and heights stay in pixels, since the dimension proofs rest on them. The plugin writes no length tokens.
